and.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc function_definition JOIN pg_namespace function_schema ON function_schema.oid = function_definition.pronamespace WHERE function_schema.nspname = current_schema() AND function_definition.proname = 'dts_reject_rollback_evidence_mutation'

SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger trigger_definition JOIN pg_class trigger_table ON trigger_table.oid = trigger_definition.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace table_schema ON table_schema.oid = trigger_table.relnamespace JOIN pg_proc trigger_function ON trigger_function.oid = trigger_definition.tgfoid JOIN pg_namespace function_schema ON function_schema.oid = trigger_function.pronamespace WHERE trigger_definition.tgname IN ( 'trg_rollback_audit_no_truncate', 'trg_ingestion_rollback_evidence_no_truncate' ) AND NOT trigger_definition.tgisinternal AND ( table_schema.nspname <> current_schema() OR function_schema.nspname <> current_schema() OR trigger_function.proname <> 'dts_reject_rollback_evidence_mutation' OR trigger_definition.tgtype <> 34 OR trigger_definition.tgenabled NOT IN ('O', 'A') OR NOT ( ( trigger_definition.tgname = 'trg_rollback_audit_no_truncate' AND trigger_table.relname = 'rollback_audit_log' ) OR ( trigger_definition.tgname = 'trg_ingestion_rollback_evidence_no_truncate' AND trigger_table.relname = 'ingestion_rollback_affected_object' ) ) )
